page.overview:
Who is Annihilator?

The Autobots stopped Destro from selling Cybertronian technology. When Prowl cornered Destro, a contingent of Annihilators and T.A.R.G.A.T.s arrived to retrieve him. An Annihilator took Destro to safety while the others faced the Autobots.

Annihilators only appeared in Operation: Dragonfire and never spoke.

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Annihilators were introduced in the 1989 series of A Real American Hero toys. ---- Appearance: orange helmet with purple visor; orange shirt with purple vest and gloves; gold braids on vest; purple and orange pants with silver holsters and gold buckle; purple boots with gold laces
